body:
QA run record — 18.0 round-4 supplementary sweep, the #24681 targeted pass (18.x steps 5 and 6, the upgrade ceremony opened), record 1 of 3: Tier 1 re-run of every pinned item a #24681 source file maps to. Framework `307ce4c4`. Maintainer-approved (dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, 2026-10-20). Wave anchor: #24579. Previous round: round 3 at `580fd4ed` (#24779 surface:api, #24786 surface:cli, #24787 surface:build). Sister records: #24838 (`upgrade:ceremony`) and `t2:24681-touched` (close-out comment).

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework `307ce4c4b42503347d7f85825f572e4ca058b05f` (pinned, detached). No console build; objectui-only pins are not runnable here.
- Cold tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (21 s), `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76, 7m29s), `check-dev-prereqs` green.
- vitest per package, one package at a time, `--maxWorkers=1`, JSON reporter per package; cli `*.e2e.test.*` pins in their own invocation under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`, every other cli pin without it (RUNNER `OS_TEST_TIERS` fact). No server of the run was alive while the pins ran except this pass's own HTTP runners (never more than 2).
- Timestamps (UTC, 2026-10-20): unit pins 08:13–08:33; nightly + dogfood pins 08:34–08:42; one missed pin re-run 09:06; clause mapping 08:47–09:05.
- Clause mapping: three parallel read-only mapping subagents (28/27/27 items), each re-deriving clause by clause from the item text and the pin source, re-read by the parent. Sequential pin execution by the parent.

## Scope

Selector `tier1:24681-touched`. Population: the #24681 merge commit `12d14765c7`'s changed files (`git diff --name-only 12d14765c7^1 12d14765c7`) minus tests, changesets, `.md`/`.mdx`, the checklist area JSONs and `.github/` — 49 files — each resolved with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs file:PATH --json`. Union: 176 runnable items (no `planned`), of which **82 carry `automated.ref`** (read from `areas/AREA.json`). Those 82 are this record's denominator. (With the two checklist area JSONs and `lint.yml` counted, the union is 178 / 84; the extra two pinned items are `ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport` and `identity-auth.teams-bu-membership`, reached only through `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` — not product source, so not in this pass.)

Revisions: each row below carries the revision its verdict is valid for.

## Pin run

**189 pin files, 4953 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** across 29 packages; every named file that exists in this checkout was collected and ran at least one test (none collected zero). One pin was first missed by the ref parser (`integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle`'s parenthesised "(+ __tests__/envelope.conformance.test.ts)") and run separately: 24/24.

Not runnable here, scored not-run:
- objectui-only refs: `automation.screen-flow-roundtrip`, `i18n.surface-matrix`, `records-forms.cascading-options`, `records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save`, `records-forms.related-list-server-pagination` (its pin is marked stale), `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching`; the objectui halves of `records-forms.cascading-multilevel-and-clear`, `records-forms.list-view-capabilities`, `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board`, `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip`.
- Playwright spec `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` (`platform-core.nav-surfaces-render`, `records-forms.view-type-gallery`): browser, not run (no console this pass).

## How a pin scores (RUNNER rule 6, "a pin scores only the layer it drives")

PR #24811 (which adds that paragraph to rule 6) is not on `main` at `307ce4c4`; this record applies its meaning. Each row names the layer its pins drive: `unit` (functions or handlers with fakes), `in-process` (a real kernel/engine/driver in the test process), `http-in-process` (a real Hono adapter in-process, e.g. the dogfood harness), `live-boot` (a spawned server or CLI). A clause whose oracle is an API answer, a boot log or a shell exit code is scored `pass (pin)` only when a pin drives that layer; otherwise it is not-run with "pin drives only LAYER". A negative that states only a runner or recording rule is `procedural` and counts as not-run.
